about: Vernon Litigation Group works from Kraft Road and is the unusual entry in this ranking: its practice is investment and securities disputes alongside real estate, and it publishes more about arbitration than about closings. Ten people named, in English and Spanish.
It states that it works on a flat fee for some matters without printing a figure, names one stage of a transaction, and says nothing about where client money is held. 144 reviews at 4.9.
